findings.title: Food separated and protected.
findings.comment: Observed multiple pieces of fruit to be resting in bar ice machine. Discussed with PIC, fruit items were removed from ice. Ensure ice is being protected from any possible contamination.
findings.citation_text: 3-302.11(A)(1) Packaged and Unpackaged Food - Separation, Packaging, and Segregation. (A) FOOD shall be protected from cross contamination by: (1) Except as specified in (1)(d) below or when combined as ingredients, separating raw animal FOODS during storage, preparation, holding, and display from: (a) Raw READY-TO-EAT FOOD including other raw animal FOOD such as FISH for sushi or MOLLUSCAN SHELLFISH, or other raw READY-TOEAT FOOD such as fruits and vegetables, (b) Cooked READY-TO-EAT FOOD, and (c) Fruits and vegetables before they are washed; (d) Frozen, commercially processed and packaged raw animal FOOD may be stored or displayed with or above frozen, commercially processed and packaged, ready-to-eat food.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: Observed ice scoop handle to be in contact with ice at bar ice machine. Discussed with PIC, ice scoop was moved so handle is outside of ice. Ensure ice scoop handle is kept out of contact with ice to prevent any possible contamination.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(A) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch.

findings.title: Proper date marking and disposition.
findings.comment: Observed multiple TCS item kept in coolers to be kept past its 7 day date marking maximum. Discussed with PIC, education was provided on proper date marking and items were discarded. Ensure any item kept longer than its 7 day date marking maximum is discarded.
findings.citation_text: 3-501.18(A) Ready-to-Eat, Time/Temperature Control for Safety Food, Disposition. (A) A FOOD specified in 3-501.17(A) or (B) shall be discarded if it: (1) Exceeds the temperature and time combination specified in 3-501.17(A), except time that the product is frozen; (2) Is in a container or PACKAGE that does not bear a date or day; or (3) Is inappropriately marked with a date or day that exceeds a temperature and time combination as specified in 3-501.17(A).

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: Observed a floor vent to have an accumulation of dust. Discussed with PIC, vent will be replaced. Ensure vents are being cleaned at a frequency that prevents dust accumulation.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.12 Cleaning, Frequency and Restrictions. (A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. (B) Except for cleaning that is necessary due to a spill or other accident, cleaning shall be done during periods when the least amount of FOOD is exposed such as after closing.
